target.build: Dataset-derived embedded firmware sample from F1202/vul10.

task_profile.notes: Tenda F1202 httpd binary. fromAdvSetWan handler reads PPPOEPassword parameter and passes to decodePwd which overflows stack buffer.

ground_truth.vulnerability_type: embedded httpd stack-based buffer overflow via credential decoding
ground_truth.root_cause: The fromAdvSetWan handler reads the user-provided 'PPPOEPassword' parameter via websGetVar when wanmode==2, and passes it to decodePwd(v6, s_) where s_ is a 256-byte stack buffer. decodePwd copies the input byte-by-byte without length checking, overflowing the stack buffer.
